reviewer.notes: Independently re-ran both named probes from a clean checkout of origin/cursor/p2-loop-to-green-0db0 (base_sha f9241354b3d34c566685c45837383c4ee6c487b1) and cross-checked every headline number with a second, independently-written measurement method (grep/ls instead of the probe's own regex parser) rather than trusting the artifact prose. HEADLINE NUMBERS CONFIRMED: (1) promised platforms = ['linux','macos','windows'] with mentions linux=3, windows=8, macos=1 -- independently recomputed via grep -noiE against README.md (7 windows hits: lines 41,192,210,212,240,241,270; 3 linux hits: lines 192,239x2; 1 macos hit: line 192) plus AGENTS.md (1 windows hit: line 98) = windows total 8, matches exactly. (2) runs_on_entries=19 across workflow_files=12 -- independently recomputed via grep -rn 'runs-on:' .github/workflows/*.yml | wc -l = 19, and grep -rhoE 'runs-on:\s*.+' | sort | uniq -c shows all 19 are literally 'ubuntu-latest' with zero windows-latest/macos-latest/matrix.os entries anywhere in the 12 workflow files. (3) families_exercised=['linux'], promised_minus_exercised=['macos','windows'], windows_promised_but_underexercised=True -- follows directly from (1)+(2) and is not disputable given zero non-ubuntu runners exist. (4) windows_defects_named=3 -- independently opened all three upstream audit artifacts (AUD-0019-eol-contract-audit.json state=SUCCESS, AUD-0082-windows-path-hazard-census.json state=BLOCKED, AUD-0085-encoding-bom-mojibake-census.json state=SUCCESS) and confirmed each exists, is a real file with a real headline, and each headline text matches word-for-word what probe2's raw output prints; count of MEASURED-status defects is exactly 3, matching the receipt. (5) macos defect_count=0 -- attempted to falsify by grepping the entire command-center/audit/*.json corpus for any macos/macOS mention (4 files hit: AUD-0027 which is about third-party PyPI wheel platform tags not a repo-native defect, AUD-0041 which is a foreign/example repo's job matrix used as an unrelated control fixture, AUD-0084 which lists a macOS check as an unexecuted 'settling_experiment', and AUD-0049 itself) -- found no counterexample; the 'no already-measured macOS-unique defect' claim survives falsification attempts and the artifact honestly lists it as a residual_unknown (NOT-CHECKED) rather than claiming a false negative was proven. (6) Both-states negative control AUD0049-C1 fired_on_bad_state=True, silent_on_good_state=True, ok=True on rerun -- verified the control logic: the fabricated full-coverage BAD state (claiming families=[linux,windows,macos] while real_windows_runs_on_count=0) is correctly rejected, and the GOOD state (real ubuntu-only matrix) is correctly silent (no false alarm) while still flagging windows_promised_but_underexercised=True. Re-running both probes on a fresh checkout reproduced probe1-matrix-diff.json and probe2-absent-defects.json byte-for-byte except for four workflow-file line-number offsets (1604->1613, 1635->1644, 1681->1690, 1757->1766 in quality.yml) caused by unrelated upstream edits to that file between receipt creation and this review; no substantive count, family, or defect-id changed. probe2 outputs and both control JSON files reproduced with zero diff. Verified command-center/audit/AUD-0049-runner-matrix-vs-support.json state is still 'BLOCKED' and reviewer.verdict is still 'NOT-REVIEWED' -- I did NOT edit or promote that receipt, per instructions. CONCLUSION: could not falsify any headline count; the audit's measurements are reproducible from a clean checkout using independent tooling and its BLOCKED state (pending exactly this kind of review) is the correct state for the packer to leave until a separate promotion step runs.
